Add.context: Imperative button verb: create a new row — a new item at the end of a checklist, or a new checklist from the floating button. Sense: create/append something new, not 'add up' numbers and not 'add to cart'. Must compose into 'Add new checklist'.

Anonymous Usage Data.context: The opt-in diagnostics the app may send: aggregate, non-identifying information about how the app is used. 'Anonymous' = not linked to the user's identity or Apple Account; 'usage data' = how the app is used, NOT the user's own content (item names and notes are never included). Trap: not 'user data', not 'personal data', not network/cellular 'data usage'. Keep one canonical rendering across the consent sheet and Settings.

translations.ja: 匿名の使用状況データ
translations.th: ข้อมูลการใช้งานแบบไม่ระบุตัวตน
translations.vi: Dữ liệu sử dụng ẩn danh

App Store.context: Apple's storefront, in the main-menu row 'Rate in App Store' that opens the app's review page. Render it exactly as Apple writes it for this locale — in most locales that means leaving 'App Store' verbatim in English; never invent a translation.

Apple Account.context: The user's Apple sign-in identity (Apple's current name for what was formerly the Apple ID), used in privacy copy: 'Data is never linked to your Apple Account.' Use Apple's own current localized term for this locale; keep 'Apple' verbatim and do not fall back to the older 'Apple ID' wording.

Cancel.context: Imperative button verb that dismisses a confirmation alert without performing the action — the standard iOS alert Cancel. Trap: NOT cancelling a subscription, order, or reservation; use the platform-standard alert-dismissal wording Apple uses on iOS in this language.

Checkbox.context: The small tick box control at the left of each item row that the user taps to mark the item complete. Use the platform-standard iOS/accessibility term for this control in the target language; it is read aloud by VoiceOver, so prefer the term a screen-reader user expects.

translations.th: ช่องทำเครื่องหมาย

Checked.context: State of a checkbox whose item has been ticked/completed. Spoken aloud as the checkbox's value, so it must pair with 'Unchecked' as a clean opposite. Trap: the 'ticked' sense, not 'inspected', 'verified', or 'checked in'.

translations.th: ทำเครื่องหมายแล้ว

Checklist.context: The app's central domain noun: a REUSABLE list of tasks the user ticks through, then resets and runs again — not a one-off to-do list, not a form, not a survey. Pick one natural local word for this and use it everywhere, including inside compounds ('Checklist Name', 'Add new checklist', 'Checklists Menu') and in the plural. Trap: do not drift between a 'list' word in one screen and a 'checklist' loanword in another.

Delete.context: Destructive imperative verb: permanently remove a checklist (swipe action and the red confirmation button). Sense: erase/remove for good, not 'cancel', 'archive', 'hide', or 'clear'. Must read as clearly destructive and stay distinct from 'Reset', which only clears ticks.

Done.context: Keyboard-accessory button that ends text editing and dismisses the keyboard — the standard iOS 'Done'. Trap: it does NOT mean an item is finished/completed; it means 'finish editing'. Use the exact wording Apple uses for the iOS keyboard Done button, and keep it distinct from any word chosen for a completed checklist item.

Feedback.context: Main-menu row that opens a pre-addressed email to the developer, plus its mail subject. Sense: the user's comments and suggestions sent to the developer. Trap: not performance-review feedback and not audio feedback. Must stay consistent with the 'Send Feedback' button on the error screen.

translations.th: ข้อเสนอแนะ

Item.context: One tickable row inside a checklist — a single task line with a checkbox, an optional name and optional notes. Always the sense of 'checklist item', never a product/shopping item, a menu entry, or a data record. Must compose with the domain noun ('checklist item', 'item names', 'item notes').

Menu.context: A popover of actions opened from a toolbar button — 'Checklists Menu' (checklist actions such as Reset All), 'Miscellaneous Menu' (feedback, rating, settings), and 'Close menu'. Sense: a UI menu of commands. Trap: not a restaurant menu. These are VoiceOver labels, so use the platform-standard accessibility term and keep one word across all three.

Name.context: The title a user gives a checklist or an item — used as a text-field placeholder and inside labels ('Checklist Name'). Sense: the label/title of a thing, NOT a person's name. Keep it short enough for a field placeholder.

Never.context: Stands alone in place of a date in the 'Last updated: %@' / 'Last completed: %@' captions when the checklist has never been touched, and also appears in privacy copy ('Data is never linked…', 'Never included:'). Must read naturally as a standalone value after a colon. Trap: choose the temporal 'not at any time' sense, not a refusal interjection.

Not Now.context: Decline button on the one-time analytics consent sheet — a soft, postponable 'no' (the choice can be changed later in Settings), not a hard refusal and not 'Cancel'. Use the standard iOS 'Not Now' wording Apple uses for deferring a system prompt in this language.

translations.th: ไม่ใช่ตอนนี้

Notes.context: Free-text field holding the user's own optional remarks — attached to a checklist header and to each item. Used as a short field placeholder, so keep it brief. Sense: annotation/remarks the user writes. Traps: not 'notification', not a musical note, not an invoice/credit note, not a footnote. Same word must serve 'Checklist Notes', 'optional notes', and 'item notes'.

Privacy Policy.context: Settings row that opens the app's privacy policy web page. Use the standard legal/platform term for a published privacy policy document in this language — the same phrasing users see in App Store listings.

translations.ja: プライバシーポリシー
translations.th: นโยบายความเป็นส่วนตัว

Reset.context: Imperative verb: uncheck every item in ONE checklist so the list can be run again. It clears progress only — it never deletes the checklist, its items, or any text. Traps: NOT 'factory reset', NOT 'reset password', NOT 'restore defaults', NOT 'delete'. Choose a base form that composes cleanly into 'Reset All'.

Reset All.context: Action that unchecks every item in EVERY checklist at once — a popover row and the confirmation button behind an 'cannot be undone' alert. Clears all progress; never deletes any list or item. 'All' scopes over all checklists, not all items of one. Build it from the agreed translation of 'Reset' so the two read as one family.

translations.th: รีเซ็ตทั้งหมด

Send Feedback.context: Button on the database-failure screen that opens a pre-filled support email containing the error details (no personal data). Compose it from the agreed 'Feedback' noun so the error screen and the main menu use the same word.

translations.ja: フィードバックを送信
translations.th: ส่งข้อเสนอแนะ

Settings.context: The app's Settings screen, the main-menu row that opens it, and — in 'Sign in to iCloud in Settings' — the iOS system Settings app. Use exactly the word Apple uses for the iOS Settings app in this language, so both senses match. Trap: not 'configuration', 'preferences', 'options', or 'adjustments' unless that is genuinely Apple's iOS term for the locale.

translations.th: การตั้งค่า

Share Anonymous Usage Data.context: EXACT REPEATED STRING — must be byte-identical in both places: the accept button on the one-time consent sheet and the label of the opt-in toggle in Settings. 'Share' = allow the app to send this data, not share with other people or via a share sheet. Build it on the agreed 'Anonymous Usage Data' rendering, and keep it short enough for a toggle label.

translations.ja: 匿名の使用状況データを共有
translations.th: แชร์ข้อมูลการใช้งานแบบไม่ระบุตัวตน
translations.ur: گمنام استعمال کا ڈیٹا شیئر کریں
translations.vi: Chia sẻ dữ liệu sử dụng ẩn danh

Start Over.context: Destructive recovery action on the database-failure screen: delete all local data and relaunch the app as if newly installed. Appears as the button 'Start over fresh', the alert title 'Start over fresh?', and the confirmation button 'Start Over' — one canonical phrasing must carry all three. Sense: begin again from nothing, WITH data loss. Trap: not 'restart the app', not 'reset', not 'retry'.

translations.th: เริ่มต้นใหม่

Sync.context: Verb and noun for keeping the user's checklists identical across their devices through iCloud ('sync your checklists across devices', 'retry iCloud sync'). Use Apple's established iOS wording for synchronization in this language; one root must serve both the verb and the noun, and must match the one used inside 'iCloud Sync'.

Unchecked.context: State of a checkbox whose item is not yet ticked — the direct opposite of 'Checked' and must be formed from the same root so the pair reads symmetrically. Trap: the 'not ticked' sense, not 'unverified' or 'unrestrained'.

translations.th: ยังไม่ได้ทำเครื่องหมาย

Version.context: Settings label shown next to the app's version and build number. Sense: software release number. Trap: not a 'variant' or 'edition' of a document, and not a translated 'version' of a text. Keep it short — it sits at the left of a right-aligned number.

iCloud.context: PROTECTED — never translate or transliterate. Apple's sync/storage service, written verbatim as 'iCloud' in every locale. Applies wherever it appears, including inside 'iCloud Sync', 'Sign in to iCloud', and 'Apple or iCloud identifiers'.

iCloud Sync.context: Feature name for syncing checklists through iCloud: a Settings section header plus the status rows 'iCloud Sync is Active' and 'iCloud Sync Paused'. Keep 'iCloud' verbatim and use the agreed 'Sync' rendering; the same compound must appear identically in the header and every status row.

translations.th: การซิงค์ iCloud

reChecklist.context: PROTECTED — never translate, transliterate, or recapitalize. The app's own name. Keep it verbatim as 'reChecklist' (lowercase 'r', capital 'C') in every locale and every script, including in email subject lines. Do not translate the embedded word 'Checklist' inside it.
